request: Create two cover parts, that have matching outer shape to the outer contour of the central part, sit flush on its outer surface and its counterpart on the other side and have thickness of 0,254cm

actions.operation: Create two cover parts with outer shapes matching the outer contour of the central part.

parameters.profile_definition: Rounded-square outer silhouette of the front and rear central hub blocks
parameters.extrusion_direction: Normal to the hub outer faces, along the positive-y direction for the front cover and the negative-y direction for the rear cover

actions.target: Outer contour of the central part
actions.relational_constraint: The outer shape of each cover part must match the outer contour of the central part.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the central part and determine which contour constitutes its outer contour.
steps: Interpret the visually central part as the opposed rounded-square hub housing formed by SEC-03 and SEC-04. The front and back multiviews show the same rounded-square central silhouette on opposite sides of the crossed arms, while the left, right, top, and bottom views confirm that the two cover locations are opposed along the y-axis.
Use SEC-03 as the reference for the first profile. The seating plane is the front annular rim, face code 0024, Brep_id FACE 53, at approximately y=27.94 mm.
Start a new sketch on face 0024, or on a datum plane coincident with face 0024 and normal to the central y-axis. Do not modify, remove, or merge the existing front hub block.

Project or convert the maximum external rounded-square silhouette of SEC-03 into the sketch. Derive the four straight portions from outer wall faces 0025, 0027, 0029, and 0031 and the rounded corner portions from faces 0026, 0028, 0030, and 0032. Preserve the existing approximately 50.8 mm overall body envelope and approximately 7.62 mm outer corner radii rather than redrawing an unrelated nominal square.

Select only the closed external perimeter. Do not include the inner boundary of annular rim 0024 or the recessed-panel boundaries associated with faces 0034 through 0042; the requested component is a solid cover plate rather than an annular frame.

Extrude the closed front profile by 2.54 mm in the positive-y direction, away from SEC-03. Set the feature result to New Body or New Part so that the cover remains a separate component and does not fuse with STEP SOLID 2.
Create the counterpart as a second independent cover body using SEC-04. Start a sketch on rear annular rim face 0043, Brep_id FACE 72, at approximately y=-15.24 mm, or on a coincident datum plane.

Project the rear hub block's external rounded-square silhouette from outer wall faces 0044, 0046, 0048, and 0050 and corner faces 0045, 0047, 0049, and 0051. Use the external loop only and omit recessed-panel boundaries associated with faces 0053 through 0061.
Extrude the rear profile by 2.54 mm in the negative-y direction, away from SEC-04, as a second New Body or New Part.

Keep both cover profiles coaxially centered at x=0 and z=0 on the central pivot axis defined by SEC-05. Preserve matching orientation between the straight sides and rounded corners of each cover and its corresponding hub block.
Do not add holes, pockets, chamfers, fillets, fasteners, or clearance features because none are specified. The projected rounded-square contour already carries the required corner transitions.
Verify that exactly two new solids have been created, that each has a constant 2.54 mm thickness, and that neither cover intersects the crossed support arms SEC-01 and SEC-02.

actions.operation: Position one created cover part flush on an outer surface of the central part.

parameters.mating_surface: Rear planar face of the front cover
parameters.reference_surface: Front annular rim at y=27.94 mm
parameters.orientation: Cover thickness projects away from the assembly in the positive-y direction

actions.target: One created cover part and an outer surface of the central part
actions.relational_constraint: The cover part must sit flush on the selected outer surface.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the intended outer surface and side of the central part for the first cover.
steps: Select SEC-03 as the front-side central housing identified in the front and top-right isometric views.
Use front annular rim face 0024, Brep_id FACE 53, as the primary flush seating reference because it is the frontmost planar surface of SEC-03 at approximately y=27.94 mm.
Apply a planar coincident or flush mate between face 0024 and the rear planar face of the newly created front cover. Set the separation or mate offset to 0 mm.
Orient the cover so its 2.54 mm thickness extends from y=27.94 mm to approximately y=30.48 mm. Reverse the extrusion or mate direction if the cover projects inward into the recessed panel.
Apply a concentric or coordinate alignment constraint so that the cover center is coincident with the central pivot axis at x=0 and z=0, corresponding to SEC-05.
Lock in-plane rotation by aligning the cover's positive-x and positive-z straight edges with the corresponding outer walls of SEC-03, particularly face codes 0027 and 0029.

Confirm that the cover's mating face contacts the annular rim without entering the recessed center bounded by faces 0035 through 0042. The center may bridge over face 0034 because that panel is recessed relative to the annular rim.
Maintain the cover as a separate part after positioning; do not boolean-union it with SEC-03 unless a later manufacturing instruction explicitly requires a permanent bonded cover.

actions.operation: Position the counterpart cover part on the other side of the central part.

parameters.mating_surface: Front planar face of the rear cover
parameters.reference_surface: Rear annular rim at y=-15.24 mm
parameters.orientation: Cover thickness projects away from the assembly in the negative-y direction
parameters.counterpart_relationship: Opposed to and aligned with the front cover about the arm mid-plane

actions.target: The second created cover part and the opposite outer surface of the central part
actions.relational_constraint: The second cover must be the counterpart of the first, located on the other side and flush with the corresponding outer surface.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the surface on the side opposite the first cover and establish its correspondence to the first selected outer surface.
steps: Select SEC-04 as the rear-side counterpart to SEC-03. Its location and geometry are confirmed by the back view and by the opposed hub blocks visible in the left, right, top, and bottom views.
Use rear annular rim face 0043, Brep_id FACE 72, as the flush seating reference. This is the rearmost planar rim at approximately y=-15.24 mm.
Apply a planar coincident or flush mate between face 0043 and the inward-facing planar face of the newly created rear cover. Set the separation or mate offset to 0 mm.
Orient the 2.54 mm extrusion away from the arm and hub stack in the negative-y direction, placing the outer rear cover face at approximately y=-17.78 mm.
Align the rear cover center with x=0 and z=0 and with the common y-axis of SEC-05 so that both covers and the pivot stack are coaxially located.
Constrain the rear cover's straight edges and rounded corners to correspond to rear outer wall faces 0044, 0046, 0048, and 0050 and corner faces 0045, 0047, 0049, and 0051.

Where the assembly system supports symmetry constraints, relate the rear cover to the front cover as the opposed counterpart about the arm mid-plane y=6.35 mm. Account for the opposite outward extrusion direction rather than translating both covers in the same direction.
Confirm that the rear cover seats on rim face 0043 and bridges over recessed panel face 0053 without colliding with inner rim faces 0054 through 0061.

Perform a final interference and section-view check through the y-axis. Verify zero gaps at both annular rim interfaces, no penetration into SEC-03, SEC-04, or SEC-05, matching rounded-square external profiles, and equal 2.54 mm cover thicknesses.

intention: Provide cover components for the central part on both sides.
